import os, pathlib, signal, subprocess, tempfile, time, json
root=pathlib.Path('/Users/voightkampff/dev/sunholo-data/stapledons-godot-iter80')
tmp=pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='iter80-supervisor-'))
rows=[]
for escaped in (False,True):
    childfile=tmp/('escape.pid' if escaped else 'group.pid')
    # Explicitly registered child ignores graceful signals. Only the escaped arm changes PGID.
    code='use POSIX qw(setsid); my $f=shift; my $e=shift; my $p=fork; die unless defined $p; if(!$p){ setsid() if $e; $SIG{TERM}=$SIG{HUP}=$SIG{INT}="IGNORE"; open my $o, ">", $f or die; print $o "$$\\n"; close $o; sleep 60; exit } sleep 60;'
    log=tmp/('escape.log' if escaped else 'group.log')
    cmd=['sh',str(root/'tools/script_gate.sh'),'repro',str(log),'2','^fixture: [1-9][0-9]* passed, 0 failures$','--','perl','-e',code,str(childfile),str(int(escaped))]
    run=subprocess.Popen(cmd,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,text=True,start_new_session=True)
    child=None
    try:
        stop=time.monotonic()+3
        while not childfile.exists() and time.monotonic()<stop: time.sleep(.05)
        assert childfile.exists(),'fixture never registered'
        child=int(childfile.read_text().strip().replace('\\n',''))
        cp=subprocess.run(['ps','-o','pid=,ppid=,pgid=,stat=','-p',str(os.getpid())+','+str(child)],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True)
        assert str(os.getpid()) in cp.stdout and str(child) in cp.stdout,'positive control failed'
        out,_=run.communicate(timeout=10)
        after=subprocess.run(['ps','-o','stat=','-p',str(child)],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout.strip()
        live=bool(after) and not after.startswith('Z')
        row={'escaped':escaped,'runner_rc':run.returncode,'child_live_after':live,'before_ps':cp.stdout.strip(),'after_stat':after,'output':out.strip()}
        rows.append(row)
        assert run.returncode==1 and 'timeout after 2 s' in out
        assert live==escaped, row
    finally:
        if child:
            try: os.kill(child,signal.SIGKILL)
            except ProcessLookupError: pass
        try: os.killpg(run.pid,signal.SIGKILL)
        except ProcessLookupError: pass
        if run.poll() is None: run.wait(timeout=3)
(tmp/'results.json').write_text(json.dumps(rows,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({'artifact':str(tmp/'results.json'),'rows':rows},indent=2))
